source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for Crossdernott in the Irish News list of the Dungannon Rural Council nominations for all nineteen divisions ('There will be no contest in any of the divisions'), read on the block image (INW19330419.2.94, block 7) and keyed twice from two fetches at different widths (no differences); no contests (Belfast News-Letter, 19 April 1933, p. 14)

note: Triennial election of the Dungannon rural district councillors, 1933. Nominations were received on Tuesday 18 April 1933; the Irish News of 19 April 1933, p. 6 prints the nominee for every division and 'There will be no contest in any of the divisions'. No party labels are printed. No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 31 May 1933. Returned unopposed.
